sentences.en: Daniel was far from home
sentences.pt: Daniel estava longe de casa

sentences.en: In Babylon, Daniel was called Belteshazzar
sentences.pt: Na Babilônia, Daniel foi chamado Beltessazar

sentences.en: The king gave them his food and his wine
sentences.pt: O rei lhes deu do seu manjar e do seu vinho

sentences.en: Daniel purposed in his heart not to defile himself
sentences.pt: Daniel assentou no seu coração não se contaminar

sentences.en: Give us vegetables to eat and water to drink
sentences.pt: Que se nos deem legumes a comer e água a beber

sentences.en: Test your servants for ten days
alt: Prove your servants for ten days
sentences.pt: Experimenta os teus servos por dez dias

sentences.en: After ten days they looked healthier than the other young men
sentences.pt: Ao fim de dez dias, pareciam mais saudáveis que os outros jovens

sentences.en: God gave them knowledge and wisdom
sentences.pt: Deus lhes deu conhecimento e sabedoria

sentences.en: The king found them ten times wiser than all his magicians
alt: The king found them ten times better than all his magicians
sentences.pt: O rei os achou dez vezes mais doutos que todos os seus magos

sentences.en: Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great statue
sentences.pt: Nabucodonosor sonhou com uma grande estátua

sentences.en: A stone broke the statue into pieces
sentences.pt: Uma pedra quebrou a estátua em pedaços

sentences.en: Our God is able to deliver us from the fiery furnace
sentences.pt: O nosso Deus nos pode livrar da fornalha de fogo ardente

verse.text: Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat.
verse.pt: Daniel assentou no seu coração não se contaminar com a porção do manjar do rei.

reading.text: Daniel was taken from Jerusalem to Babylon. King Nebuchadnezzar had a dream about a great statue of gold, silver, brass and iron. A stone broke the statue into pieces. God showed Daniel the dream and its meaning.
reading.pt: Daniel foi levado de Jerusalém para a Babilônia. O rei Nabucodonosor teve um sonho com uma grande estátua de ouro, prata, bronze e ferro. Uma pedra quebrou a estátua em pedaços. Deus mostrou a Daniel o sonho e o seu significado.
reading.q: What broke the statue into pieces?

dialogue.line: Daniel, the king gave you his food and his wine.
dialogue.pt: Daniel, o rei lhe deu do seu manjar e do seu vinho.
options: Please, give us vegetables and water for ten days.
Bring me a harp and a sling.
dialogue.answer: Please, give us vegetables and water for ten days.
dialogue.answerPt: Por favor, dê-nos legumes e água por dez dias.

quiz.q: Who was thrown into the fiery furnace?
quiz.explain: Sadraque, Mesaque e Abede-Nego não adoraram a estátua de ouro e foram lançados na fornalha, mas Deus os livrou (Daniel 3:17-27).

sentences.en: Daniel was faithful to God
sentences.pt: Daniel era fiel a Deus

sentences.en: The king made a law
sentences.pt: O rei fez uma lei

sentences.en: For thirty days they could only pray to the king
sentences.pt: Por trinta dias, só podiam orar ao rei

sentences.en: Darius signed the decree
sentences.pt: Dario assinou o decreto

sentences.en: The law of the Medes and Persians cannot be changed
sentences.pt: A lei dos medos e dos persas não se pode revogar

sentences.en: He prayed with his window open toward Jerusalem
alt: He prayed with his windows open toward Jerusalem
sentences.pt: Ele orava com a janela aberta do lado de Jerusalém

sentences.en: Daniel prayed three times a day
sentences.pt: Daniel orava três vezes ao dia

sentences.en: He kneeled, prayed and gave thanks to his God
alt: He knelt, prayed and gave thanks to his God
sentences.pt: Ele se punha de joelhos, orava e dava graças ao seu Deus

sentences.en: They threw Daniel into the den
sentences.pt: Eles lançaram Daniel na cova

sentences.en: A stone was laid upon the mouth of the lions' den
sentences.pt: Uma pedra foi posta sobre a boca da cova dos leões

sentences.en: Darius sealed the stone with his own signet
alt: Darius sealed the stone with his own ring
sentences.pt: Dario selou a pedra com o seu anel

sentences.en: The king could not sleep that night
sentences.pt: Naquela noite, o rei não conseguiu dormir

verse.text: He kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God.
verse.pt: Três vezes no dia se punha de joelhos, e orava, e dava graças diante do seu Deus.

reading.text: King Darius set Daniel over all the princes, because an excellent spirit was in him. The princes sought to find a fault in Daniel, but they found none, because he was faithful. So they asked the king to sign a law: for thirty days, pray only to the king.
reading.pt: O rei Dario pôs Daniel sobre todos os príncipes, porque nele havia um espírito excelente. Os príncipes procuraram achar culpa em Daniel, mas não acharam nenhuma, porque ele era fiel. Então pediram ao rei que assinasse uma lei: por trinta dias, orar só ao rei.
reading.q: Why could the princes find no fault in Daniel?
options: Because he hid in the den
Because he was the king's son

dialogue.line: Daniel, the king made a new law!
dialogue.pt: Daniel, o rei fez uma nova lei!
options: I will pray to my God anyway.
Then I will pray only to the king.
dialogue.answer: I will pray to my God anyway.
dialogue.answerPt: Vou orar ao meu Deus mesmo assim.

quiz.q: What did the king do with the stone on the den?
options: He sealed it with his signet
He threw it into the sea
quiz.answer: He sealed it with his signet
quiz.explain: Puseram uma pedra sobre a boca da cova, e o rei a selou com o seu anel (Daniel 6:17).

sentences.en: In the morning the king ran to the den
sentences.pt: De manhã o rei correu para a cova

sentences.en: Daniel, servant of the living God!
sentences.pt: Daniel, servo do Deus vivo!

sentences.en: Is your God able to deliver you from the lions?
sentences.pt: Pôde o teu Deus livrar-te dos leões?

sentences.en: O king, live forever
sentences.pt: Ó rei, vive para sempre!

sentences.en: God sent his angel
sentences.pt: Deus enviou o seu anjo

sentences.en: The angel shut the lions' mouths
alt: The angel closed the lions' mouths
sentences.pt: O anjo fechou a boca dos leões

sentences.en: He is the living God
sentences.pt: Ele é o Deus vivo

sentences.en: His kingdom is forever
sentences.pt: O seu reino é para sempre

sentences.en: His kingdom shall not be destroyed
alt: His kingdom will not be destroyed
sentences.pt: O seu reino não se pode destruir

sentences.en: He delivers and he saves
sentences.pt: Ele livra e salva

sentences.en: The king wrote to all the people
sentences.pt: O rei escreveu a todo o povo

sentences.en: The angel closed the mouth of the lion
sentences.pt: O anjo fechou a boca do leão

verse.text: He is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
verse.pt: Ele é o Deus vivo e para sempre permanece; e o seu reino não se pode destruir.

reading.text: The king rose very early and went in haste to the den. Daniel was alive! The king was very glad and took Daniel out of the den. No hurt was found on him, because he believed in his God.
reading.pt: O rei se levantou muito cedo e foi com pressa à cova. Daniel estava vivo! O rei ficou muito alegre e tirou Daniel da cova. Nenhum dano se achou nele, porque crera no seu Deus.
reading.q: Why was no hurt found on Daniel?
options: Because he believed in his God
reading.answer: Because he believed in his God

dialogue.line: Daniel, is your God able to save you?
dialogue.pt: Daniel, o seu Deus pode salvá-lo?
dialogue.answerPt: Sim! Deus enviou o seu anjo.

quiz.q: What happened to the men who accused Daniel?
options: They were thrown into the lions' den
quiz.answer: They were thrown into the lions' den
quiz.explain: Os homens que acusaram Daniel foram lançados na cova dos leões (Daniel 6:24).
